name: robots/gepetto__constraints-as-terminations
title: CaT Solo12 locomotion environment (Isaac Lab simulation)
intro: CaT Solo12 locomotion environment (Isaac Lab simulation), adapted from gepetto/constraints-as-terminations. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `constraint_probability`, `timed_out` and 3 more; runs `step` and `reset_world`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
